lines.en: label osakosummer2dojogen:
scene osakosummer2dojogen
I show up at the dojo and reluctantly agree to spar with Osako, a decision I immediately regret.
lines.zh: 我来到道场,极不情愿地答应了和 Osako 对练——一个我立刻就后悔的决定。

lines.en: It was only a matter of time until something like this happened again, though. There are only so many days I can go without participating in any of her lessons without getting my ass kicked.
lines.zh: 不过,这种事再次发生只是时间问题。我不参加她的任何课程、又不想挨揍的日子,毕竟是有限的。

lines.en: But hey, if that’s the price I need to pay for slacking off 99%% of the time, it’s fine.
lines.zh: 不过嘿,如果这就是我 99% 的时间都在摸鱼所要付出的代价,那也没啥。

lines.en: To be completely honest, getting beaten up by someone like her is light years better than getting beat up by some hairy dude in an alleyway somewhere.
lines.zh: 说完全实话,被她这种人揍,比被不知哪儿的小巷里某个毛茸茸的男人揍,要好上几个光年。

lines.en: And while the prospect of that ever happening to me is extremely low considering the near-complete lack of men in Kumon-mi, it’s moments like this where I need to look at the bright side of life.
lines.zh: 而且考虑到 Kumon-mi 几乎完全没有男人,那种事发生在我身上的概率极低——但正是在这种时刻,我需要看到生活光明的一面。

lines.en: And so, if this flying kick connects with one of my ribs and goes on to puncture one of my lungs, I want you to know that I died with no regrets.
lines.zh: 所以,如果这记飞踢命中我的某根肋骨、进而刺穿我的某片肺叶,我想让你知道:我死而无憾。

lines.en: Well, no regrets apart from the fact that I never got to have a threesome with Osako and her girlfriend.
lines.zh: 好吧,除了从没和 Osako 和她女朋友玩过三人行这一点,死而无憾。

lines.en: Goodbye, world.
scene black
The kick connects, but my ribs and lungs emerge unscathed and the idea of an eventual threesome is still slightly possible.
lines.zh: 踢中了。但我的肋骨和肺叶毫发无伤,而「将来三人行」的构想也仍有那么一丝可能。

lines.en: I thank the god I don’t believe in for the precious gift of life as Osako reaches down to help me up and apologize for going a little too hard.
lines.zh: 我感谢那位我不相信的神明赐予生命的宝贵礼物,与此同时 Osako 俯身把我拉起来,为自己下手略重道了歉。

lines.en: As it turns out, though, I am apparently an excellent target when it comes to letting her rage out as this sort of kick would probably kill at least 80%% of her students.
lines.zh: 不过事实证明,在让她发泄怒火这件事上,我显然是个绝佳的靶子——因为这种程度的踢击,大概率能杀掉她至少 80% 的学生。

lines.en: I’m not sure whether or not that is a good thing as it means I will likely continue to incur attacks like this in the future, but at least I’m alive.
lines.zh: 我不确定这算不算好事,因为这意味着将来我多半还得继续挨这种攻击。但至少,我还活着。

lines.en: Either way, I wind up sticking around after the rest of the class goes home and talking to Osako for a bit before she needs to get ready for her second job.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,在其他学员回家之后,我留下来和 Osako 聊了一会儿,直到她要去为第二份工作做准备。

lines.en: Once she does, I throw back on my normal clothes and head back into the street.
lines.zh: 等她走了,我套回自己的平常衣服,重新走回街上。

lines.en: I just...have to do it a little slower than normal as I am still very much in pain.
lines.zh: 只是……我得比平时走得慢一点,因为我还痛得要命。

lines.en: $ osako_love += 1
Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
lines.zh: Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
